summary: Frontend-only E2E test for (a) language selector dropdown via React Portal (b) i18n switch to English (c) SessionEditor opens WITHOUT 't is not defined' crash (d) CAPACITY_CONFIG micro-labels translation. ALL CRITICAL FLOWS PASS. Login test@train.com/test123456 → Dashboard → click language-selector-trigger → dropdown shows ALL 12 language options (es,en,pt,fr,de,ar,hi,id,ja,ko,ru,zh) each with data-testid lang-option-{code} visible and floating over content via portal (zIndex 99999, fixed). Click lang-option-en → UI re-renders in English: 'Control Panel', 'Readiness Score', 'Sessions', 'Athletes', 'Sleep quality', 'Acute:Chronic Load Ratio', 'Sessions', etc. confirmed. Navigated Data tab → 'Plan Powerlifting - Tradicional (Matveiev)' sidebar plan → section-tab-periodizacion → subnav-period-structure → expanded macrocycle-0 (Preparatorio General) → expanded mesocycle-0-0 (PG - Meso 1) → expanded microcycle-0-0-0 (Semana 1) → clicked session-0 (or session-0-edit-btn). SessionEditor MODAL OPENED CLEANLY: 0 pageerror events, NO 't is not defined', dialog title 'Session name…', tags SES-001, 'Elegir fecha', '90 min', 'Planned', sections 'Session objectives', 'General Objective', 'Physical Objective', 'Technical Objective', 'Tactical Objective', 'Psychological Objective', 'Theoretical Objective', 'Session structure', 'Fase Inicial / Principal / Final' — i18n hook working. CAPACITY_CONFIG visual verification not executed in browser because the test session has 0 actividades (empty plan template); but: (i) hook+tCap+slugCap code path verified in SessionEditor.js lines 617-618 and 1263/1270/1277/1320/1321; (ii) en.json sessions.capcfg namespace exists with 50 keys; (iii) the editor renders without any runtime error and the static labels around it are already translated correctly. Console: only a benign 404 (favicon-ish resource) and a Radix UI hydration warning about <span> child inside <option> at SessionEditor line 1493 (cosmetic, pre-existing, NOT from this change).

issues: Some labels are still Spanish even when language=EN: 'Macrociclos', 'Mesociclos', 'Semanas', 'Tonelaje', 'Mesociclo', 'Microcycles', 'Sesion', 'Estructura' (the sub-tab icon), 'Calendario', 'Grafico', 'Mesociclos' count badge, 'Semana 1..4', 'sem', 'ses', 'Load', 'RPE', '0/4'. These are NOT in scope of THIS request (the scope was language selector + SessionEditor crash + CAPACITY_CONFIG micro-labels) but should be reported because user is on EN.

Phase headers still in Spanish: 'Fase Inicial', 'Fase Principal', 'Fase Final', '0 actividades'. Bottom-bar buttons 'Compartir', 'Dark PDF', 'Light PDF', 'Dark boards', 'Light boards', 'Salir', 'Guardar', date label 'Elegir fecha' — these are NOT inside CAPACITY_CONFIG scope but should be flagged for future i18n work. Hydration warning: <span> inside <option> at SessionEditor.js line 1493 will cause React 18 hydration warnings (cosmetic, no functional break).

action_items: NONE for the three primary fixes in scope — they all work. SessionEditor opens without crash (the new useTranslation() hook + tCap helper at line 617-618 is correctly wired). Language portal dropdown shows all 12 languages. EN switch works on Dashboard.

VERIFY MANUALLY (out of automated scope because test session has 0 actividades): expand an activity in advanced view and confirm Subtype select shows 'Maximum/Explosive/Endurance' (vs 'Maxima/Explosiva/Resistencia') and volume/intensity units 'Sets/Meters/Seconds/Tasks' and zone metrics 'Z4 (Threshold)' / 'Max Strength' are translated. Suggested seed: open a session in TEST_Plan or Plan Test API that has activities, OR add an activity to the empty session and toggle to Advanced view.

OPTIONAL i18n cleanup (out of scope but visible to EN users): translate Estructura/Calendario/Grafico tabs, Macrociclos/Mesociclos/Microcycles section headers, Semana labels, sem/ses/Load/RPE micro-labels, SessionEditor phase headers (Fase Inicial/Principal/Final), 'X actividades' counter, footer buttons (Compartir/Dark PDF/Light PDF/Dark boards/Light boards/Salir/Guardar), and 'Elegir fecha' button.
OPTIONAL fix: hydration warning at SessionEditor.js:1493 — a <span data-ve-dynamic> is being rendered inside <option>. Wrap content directly as plain text in <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: SessionEditor.js: 'const { t } = useTranslation();' is now declared at line 617 inside the main editor component — fix verified. The tCap helper at line 618 correctly uses defaultValue:s so missing keys gracefully fall back to the original Spanish label.

SessionEditor.js: slugCap (line 406) normalises labels to keys. Coverage of CAPACITY_CONFIG vs en.json sessions.capcfg should be re-checked when adding new capacities/subtypes/units in the future — currently locales/en.json has 50 keys (verified non-empty: 'maxima':'Maximum','explosiva':'Explosive',...) but any new label added to CAPACITY_CONFIG must be added to all 12 locales or it'll silently fall back to Spanish.
LanguageSelector.js portal: zIndex 99999 + position:fixed via getBoundingClientRect — works correctly, no clipping, no jitter on click. Good fix.
Hydration warning in SessionEditor.js:1493 (<span> inside <option>) is unrelated to this PR but creates noise in console. Recommend cleanup.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The three reported fixes are confirmed working: (1) language portal shows 12 langs, (2) EN i18n switch works on Dashboard, (3) SessionEditor opens with NO 't is not defined' crash. To FULLY verify CAPACITY_CONFIG micro-labels visually, open a session that already has at least one activity (capacity Fuerza/Strength) and expand the advanced panel — the Subtype Select should show 'Maximum/Explosive/Endurance' instead of 'Maxima/Explosiva/Resistencia' when lang=en. Use the testids reps-adv-{faseKey}-{idx}, descanso-adv-{faseKey}-{idx}, intensity-slider-{faseKey}-{idx} to locate the advanced panel. Sessions in 'Plan Powerlifting - Tradicional (Matveiev)' Semana 1 are 'Nueva' placeholders with 0 actividades — pick a different (already populated) session or first add one.
rca_of_the_issue: Pre-existing latent bug RCA (already FIXED by main agent): SessionEditor used t(...) for placeholders without importing useTranslation, which would have thrown ReferenceError 't is not defined' at the first render of any session. Fix at SessionEditor.js:617 (const { t } = useTranslation();) plus tCap helper on line 618 mapping CAPACITY_CONFIG strings to 'sessions.capcfg.<slug>' keys. Verified in this test: opened session-0 from the Powerlifting plan in EN locale → zero pageerror events → modal renders cleanly with translated Session objectives section headers and 'No activities in this phase' English text. The 50 keys exist in locales/en.json under sessions.capcfg (grep 'capcfg' confirmed).
